_comment_model: Free-tier extraction model. Override per-run without editing this file: --model=gemini/gemini-2.5-flash (CLI) or the CROHNICITY_MODEL env var. Switched from gemini-2.5-flash-lite to dodge -lite 503 high-demand spikes (free-tier quota is per-model, so -flash has its own pool).
_comment_max_tokens: Generous output cap (headroom for a 10-patient batch JSON). Reasoning is disabled in extract.py (reasoning_effort='disable' -> thinkingBudget=0), so thinking no longer competes for this budget; 8192 had truncated the JSON mid-output -> JSONSchemaValidationError.
